title: cost-workflow-orchestrator-automate-prefill-batch-cache-and-quant-tradeoffs
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduce CostWorkflowOrchestrator: a lightweight orchestration layer that wires batch/caching defaults, quantization profile selection, and unit-econ simulation into a single automated pipeline. Adds CLI and API hooks for dry-run and apply modes, safe rollouts, and telemetry hooks.
description: Motivation: Teams repeatedly tune batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization independently which leads to inconsistent unit economics and fragile rollouts. This PR adds a new CostWorkflowOrchestrator that composes workload profiling, candidate quantization scans, batch/cache default proposals, and a lightweight unit-econ simulator into an automated workflow with guardrails. Goals: 1) reduce time-to-safe-defaults for new tenants and models; 2) provide deterministic, explainable recommendations that link changes to expected per-token cost and tail latency; 3) enable safe canaries and rollback if telemetry diverges. What this PR does: implements orchestrator service, CLI (costctl) subcommands, a small policy DSL for safe thresholds, a compact unit-econ simulator used by dry-run mode, and telemetry integrations for the Console. Design highlights: - Workflows are defined as ordered stages: profile -> candidate-gen -> sim -> propose -> canary -> apply - Candidate generation considers multiple quantization points (fp16, int8, q4_0, q4_1) and per-model latents such as KV cache hit-rate assumptions - Simulator runs probabilistic sampling using historical request shape distributions and emits expected median and P95 latency, tokens-per-second, and cost-per-1M-tokens estimates - Proposals include explicit fallbacks and a compatibility matrix so runtime can automatically route to a safe variant on degrade - Safe rollout uses incremental canary percentages, telemetry gating conditions, and automatic rollback on SLA or quality regressions Includes: - New service: internal/econ/orchestrator (controller + reconciler) - CLI: tools/costctl with dry-run/apply/canary commands - API: POST /v1/tenant/{id}/cost-workflow (create/preview) - Small policy DSL YAML + validator - Unit-econ simulator library (python) - Console telemetry hooks and dashboard config Changes are intentionally additive with feature flags to allow staged rollout. See CHECKLIST below for rollout plan.
